title: Hiring: Customer Support Executive  Non-Voice  Chat Process
description:

Ensure professional and effective written communication with customers. Follow process guidelines and escalate complex issues whenever required. Requirements Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English. Confident while interacting with and assisting customers. Typing Speed: Minimum 30 WPM. Typing Accuracy: Minimum 90%. Comfortable working in rotational shifts, including night shifts. Candidates should be comfortable working from office.
